subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers land the linked fork cleanup PR, replace it with an equivalent same-repo cleanup, or close that candidate and leave this issue as the canonical bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an open linked fork PR already references this issue with closing syntax and should be handled before ClawSweeper queues competing work.

options.title: Review or replace linked cleanup
options.body: Treat the open fork PR as the current candidate, then either land it after refresh/proof or replace it with an equivalent same-repo branch.

options.title: Close candidate, keep issue
options.body: Close the linked fork PR if it is not usable and leave this issue open as the canonical source-reproducible bug.

options.title: Defer placeholder cleanup
options.body: Leave the issue and candidate unresolved if maintainers want to sequence this behind broader Google Chat delivery lifecycle work.

recommendation.title: Review or replace linked cleanup
recommendation.body: Treat the open fork PR as the current candidate, then either land it after refresh/proof or replace it with an equivalent same-repo branch.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant current-main ownership signal is the Google Chat reply-delivery extraction and hardening that owns placeholder update/delete behavior.
